name: Classic Leasing & Finance Limited
about: Classic Leasing & Finance Limited, a non-banking finance company, engages in leasing and financing activities in India. The company offers asset financing with initial funding, mezzanine financing, and acquisition financing, as well as project funding, corporate loans, and structured debt financing. It serves the power, ports, telecom, retail, real estate, hospitality, financial services, and logistics sectors. Classic Leasing & Finance Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Kolkata, India.
